segments.slideTitle: From raw filing to cited answer — automatically.
slideBullets: Ingest — new 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K filings pulled from SEC EDGAR, 3x daily.
Analyze — Claude extracts risks, sentiment, financials, and a concern score.
Enrich — Yahoo Finance market data and a 30-day alpha signal are attached.
Ask — you (or an AI agent) query the filing and get grounded, cited answers.

segments.slideTitle: Ask a filing anything — and see the receipts.
slideBullets: Plain-English questions, answered from the filing's own text.
Every answer is grounded and cited — designed against hallucination.
Powered by Claude, Anthropic's frontier AI model.
Grounded 'key questions' Q&A on every analyzed filing and company.

segments.slideTitle: AI risk and concern scoring on every filing.
slideBullets: Risk factors compared across filings — new, removed, and escalating risks.
Management sentiment read from the MD&A on a clear scale.
A single concern score tells you which filings to read first.
8-K events auto-classified so material news never slips past you.

segments.slideTitle: A 30-day research signal — honest, not hype.
slideBullets: A model estimates each filing's 30-day return versus the S&P 500 (alpha).
Mixture-of-experts: global + per-sector + per-cap-tier models.
Trained on thousands of historical filings; walk-forward backtested.
A paper-trading portfolio tracks live performance — and it is never advice.
